patch_description:
Implement time-weighted decay for access counts and apply tighter eviction heuristics for young, low-frequency pages. This targets scan-heavy and uniform workloads that currently underperform.

Key changes:
1. Add age-based decay to access_count so that old accesses don't keep pages classified as "warm" or "hot" indefinitely.
2. More aggressively evict cold (access_count=1) pages, especially if not accessed very recently.
3. Reduce base working-set window to 500ms (from 1s) to avoid bloating cache with infrequent accesses.
4. Introduce burst-detection check: only expand working set if we're in an actual burst (small inter-arrival).
5. Apply stricter recent_access_ns (50ms base instead of 100ms) to focus on true hot set.

This maintains high performance on hot-set workloads (ycsb_a, ycsb_d, ycsb_f) while improving scan and uniform workloads.
